description:
Audit of the pull-based work (fz-go4.16/.17, diff since a705cec2) found the native path was never cut over to the pull product path, and fz-go4.17.10 was closed on a false signal.

ROOT CAUSE (drives audit findings 1-3)
Interp (run_root_interp) uses the pull product path. But compile_root_jit/run_root_jit/compile_root_aot go through native_program_for_root -> drive_root_to(Job::LowerNativeProgram(root)) -> world.drive_for, which is the UNGUARDED full drive loop (no forbidden_product_path_job; compiler.rs:118). submit_root enqueues SeedRoot (world.rs:513) which self-schedules SealSemanticClosure -> DeriveTransportPlan -> define_transport_plan (root.rs:83/365, transport.rs:961). lower_native_program declares only reads:[BackendProgram] (native.rs:73) but performs an UNDECLARED side-read of the legacy world.transport_plan store (native.rs:2950, 3425) for callable-boundary facts and hard-errors if absent (native.rs:2954). The sole writer of that store is the legacy DeriveTransportPlan job. So native runs the legacy ladder AND the pull product, and is load-bearing on legacy.

CONSEQUENCES
- fz-go4.17.10 Signal ("rg shows no production ... native ... consumer of legacy semantic closure or root transport plan") is factually false: native.rs:2950/3425.
- The legacy seal/transport spine (SealSemanticClosure, DeriveTransportPlan, DeriveExecutableTransport, DeriveRuntimeDemand, SemanticReady, SemanticClosed, ExecutableTransport, TransportPlan, root_executable_frontier) cannot be deleted while native needs it.
- HEAD lib suite is RED: base a705cec2 = 936 passed / 0 failed; HEAD = 926 / 8 failed (deterministic across two runs). The 8 are native LowerNativeProgram Fatals on callable-boundary / Enum.take fixtures.
- The JIT guard assert_no_legacy_planner_or_type_infer (compiler2_test.rs:286) only forbids the pre-compiler2 fz.type_infer / fz.planner, not the compiler2 legacy ladder, so it stayed green while the ladder ran.

GOAL
Native callable-boundary lowering sources its facts from pull products (CallableFacts / BoundaryFacts), native/JIT/AOT front doors run only the guarded product driver, the 8 native tests go green, and the legacy seal/transport spine is deleted.

SIGNAL
JIT/AOT run of quicksort + enum_reduce + the 8 failing fixtures: zero SealSemanticClosure / DeriveTransportPlan / root_executable_frontier job fires, no read of world.transport_plan, lib suite 0 failed. This finishes the work fz-go4.17.10 claimed but did not do.
title: Compiler2 native pull cutover: move native/JIT/AOT off the legacy seal/transport ladder
